2609.22038.title: QuranicMMLU: A Cognitively-Aware Benchmark for Evaluating Generative AI Solutions on Quranic Linguistic Knowledge
2609.22038.paper_summary: We introduce QuranicMMLU, a benchmark for evaluating generative AI on Quranic Arabic across multiple dimensions of linguistic complexity. Existing Quranic benchmarks center on general question answering and semantic retrieval, without probing specific linguistic competencies or stratifying by cognitive demand and verse difficulty. We construct a five-pillar Quranic taxonomy spanning Phonology, Morphology, Syntax, Semantics, and Pragmatics, with 31 leaves covering phenomena from tajwīd and root-and-pattern morphology to occasions of revelation and inter-surah coherence. For each leaf we generate questions stratified by Bloom's cognitive level and verse perplexity, then have LLM as a judge to independently answer and score every item and route the annotations to manual review. The resulting dataset comprises 980 human-reviewed questions, each issued in both open-ended and multiple-choice form. We benchmark 12 systems on these items and find that the Islamic-specialized model leads, yet every system scores higher on multiple-choice accuracy (average 84%) than open-ended answer quality (average 60%): the two rankings agree closely (Kendall's τ=0.73), but multiple-choice scoring hides failures that surface only once answer choices are removed. QuranicMMLU thus offers a rigorous, linguistically grounded framework for evaluating Arabic NLP in the Quranic domain.
2609.22038.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹了QuranicMMLU，一個用於評估生成性AI在古蘭經阿拉伯語上多維度語言複雜性的基準。現有的古蘭經基準主要集中在一般問題回答和語義檢索上，未能探討特定的語言能力或根據認知需求和經文難度進行分層。我們構建了一個涵蓋語音學、形態學、句法學、語義學和語用學的五大支柱古蘭經分類法，並設有31個分支，涵蓋從tajwīd和根-模式形態學到啟示場合和經文間一致性的現象。對於每個分支，我們生成了根據布魯姆的認知水平和經文困惑度進行分層的問題，然後讓大型語言模型作為評審獨立回答並評分每個項目，並將註釋路由到人工審查。最終的數據集包含980個經過人工審查的問題，每個問題以開放式和多選題形式發佈。我們在這些項目上基準測試了12個系統，發現專門針對伊斯蘭的模型表現最佳，但每個系統在多選題準確性（平均84%）上的得分均高於開放式回答質量（平均60%）：這兩個排名非常接近（肯德爾τ=0.73），但多選題的得分隱藏了只有在去除答案選擇後才會顯現的失敗。因此，QuranicMMLU提供了一個嚴謹、以語言學為基礎的框架，用於評估古蘭經領域的阿拉伯語自然語言處理。
